amendment_basis.explanation: The workstation exposed 112 CPUs to OpenMP despite the RunRelay task requesting 4 cores. Library-default execution timed out in a 90-second one-fold audit, while explicit 4-thread execution completed the same two-fit fold in 2.18 seconds and a full exact five-fold replicate in 11.21 seconds. Y5R7M2Q8 is therefore superseded as an environment/thread-oversubscription artifact.

primary_estimand: repeat-1 out-of-fold delta_AUROC = AUROC(rich comparator + stripped Open-Jev) - AUROC(rich comparator)

primary_uncertainty.method: patient-cluster refit bootstrap of the full repeat-1 cross-fitting procedure
primary_uncertainty.sampling_rule: sample source patients with replacement; duplicate all ICU rows by patient multiplicity; retain each patient's frozen repeat-1 fold assignment; refit both comparator and augmented models in all five folds for every replicate
primary_uncertainty.heldout_multiplicity: retain patient bootstrap multiplicity in held-out AUROC calculation
primary_uncertainty.interpretation: includes patient-sampling and model-refit variability conditional on the frozen repeat-1 fold partition; fold-partition uncertainty is assessed separately with repeats 2-5

execution_thread_contract.reason: prevent OpenMP/BLAS oversubscription on the workstation where os.cpu_count and CPU affinity expose 112 CPUs despite a 4-core RunRelay resource request

split_stability.report: delta_AUROC point estimate for each repeat plus range across repeats
split_stability.purpose: show sensitivity to refitting under alternative frozen patient-grouped fold assignments

multiplicity: No confirmatory p-values or binary significance decisions. Ventilation, RRT, and MetaVision ICU death are three prespecified co-primary estimands reported separately. No Holm testing is applied.
claim_rule: Do not label an outcome positive/negative by a p-value or CI crossing zero. Report effect estimate, refit-bootstrap interval, and split-stability estimates; interpret magnitude and uncertainty.
secondary_uncertainty: Secondary metrics and sensitivity analyses use compatible patient-cluster bootstrap intervals where feasible and do not create additional confirmatory claims.
supersedes: the fixed-prediction uncertainty version of config/v2_1_primary_inference_freeze.json committed before runtime re-audit B6R9M4Q2
